info.title: PowerHQ Plan Data API
info.description: Run sample queries against the PowerHQ Plan Data API without leaving the docs. Pick a sample from the Body dropdown, edit the values, and press Send. Requires an API key and an allow-listed egress IP.

servers.description: Public playground proxy (10 free calls per IP per day, read-only)

post.description: Single GraphQL endpoint. Choose one of the sample queries below, change the ZIP code or usage, and send. Every query listed here is read-only.

variables.description: Optional variables, when the query declares them.

utilities.summary: utilities: which utilities serve a ZIP
utilities.description: Start here. The utility IDs this returns can be passed to residentialPlans.

residentialPlans.summary: residentialPlans: residential plans for a ZIP
residentialPlans.description: Pass zipCode or utilityId. monthlyUsage calibrates the pricing.

businessPlans.summary: businessPlans: commercial plans for a ZIP
businessPlans.description: zipCode is required. annualUsageInkWh calibrates the pricing.

nextStartDate.description: isMoveIn distinguishes new service from a provider switch.

energyInfoByState.summary: energyInfoByState: state average rate and generation mix
energyInfoByState.description: Both stateCode and isBusiness are required.

200.description: GraphQL response. Field-level problems arrive here with an errors array, not as an HTTP error status.

403.description: Key is valid but the calling IP is not allow-listed.
